$comment: INK3 field codes for beskattningsperiod 2026P4, derived from Skatteverket's published field-name tables (the xls files below, from the 2026P4 SKV269 package). attribute is the xls text verbatim (whitespace collapsed); label is attribute without the ruta number and column suffix. column is set for INK3R's income statement: bokforing = "enligt redovisningen", skattepliktig = "som ska tas upp/dras av" (blankett INK3RM-2-33-2026P4). Regenerate from the next package; never edit by hand.

notes.8688: The xls attribute says "vid beskattningsårets utgång"; the printed blankett INK3SM-1-33-2026P4 (SKV269 blankettbilder 2026P4) says "vid beskattningsårets ingång". The engine computes the schablonintäkt on the opening balance, as periodiseringsfond-service does for INK2S 4.6a (IL 30 kap. 6 a §).
